title: WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.8
description: Lengthened the LR warmdown tail from half the run to 80% of the run, leaving everything else (DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.06, batch size) at the round-1 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.012957 vs round baseline 1.012413 -- slightly worse (+0.04%), within noise range of the MATRIX_LR cluster from round 0 but not an improvement. A longer, gentler decay did not help here; if anything the model may benefit from more time at peak LR rather than more time decaying. Not worth pursuing shorter-than-0.5 warmdown either without a reason to think this axis matters more than depth -- deprioritize LR schedule shape tuning in favor of the depth-scaling results landing this round.
